body.name: Geometric-mixing marginal rate scale
body.construction:
Define
\[
 R_{\mathrm{or}}
 =\left\{\sum_{s=1}^{S}\frac{\pi_s^2}{n_s}\right\}
 \vee
 \left[\sum_{s=1}^{S}\pi_s(Tn_s)^{-\lambda/(2\lambda+d)}\right]^2
 \vee
 \left\{\frac{\log(T\vee2)}{T}\right\}^{2\lambda/d},
 \qquad
 R_\star=R_{\mathrm{or}}\vee N^{-\kappa}.
\]
The last term is the worst-case pointwise spacing scale permitted by the
stated geometric beta-mixing envelope.  On the independent-calendar subclass
it is replaced by \(T^{-2\lambda/d}\).
